_comment: Starting points for musicPlan.json. Name one with "preset": "<name>", or write your own "style": { "positive": [...], "negative": [...] } and "bpm". Hear them first: npm run music -- <project> --sample=upbeat-acoustic,calm-piano (about 20 s each). Everyone's taste differs: these are only starting points. Every preset keeps one key and one tempo so separately made sections join smoothly, and rules out words.

upbeat-acoustic.about: Warm, a little upbeat acoustic pop. Used for the example video.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice, no busy lead melody

calm-piano.about: Quiet, reflective piano with soft strings. Stays out of the way; can feel slow over a long video.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice

cinematic-hopeful.about: Light film-score feel: piano, strings and soft pulse that builds. Good for vision and big-picture stories.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice

worship-acoustic.about: Instrumental contemporary worship feel: acoustic guitar, piano, gentle band.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice

african-guitar.about: Bright East African benga-style guitars, bouncy bass, light hand percussion.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice

latin-acoustic.about: Warm Latin American acoustic: nylon guitar, cajón, light percussion.
positive: leaves room for a speaking voice
